Name: Iridium Milk Cow
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]Iridium Cow adds a new late-game barn animal with its own progression path, custom milk, permanent health reward, and two selectable visual styles. [/font]

[spoiler][font=Comic Sans MS]After experiencing Mr. Qi's level-100 Skull Cavern milk event, you can buy an Iridium Livestock Permit in the Walnut Room for 100 Qi Gems. Bring the permit to Marnie, then wait until the next morning for her letter and the Iridium Cow to become available in her livestock shop.[/font][/spoiler]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
The default animal art is the Vanilla-style Iridium Cow. An optional Facelift style is also included, based on/derived from siamece's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url] assets and used under that mod's Nexus asset-use permissions with credit.

[b]Features[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]New Iridium Cow as a separate custom barn animal.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Late-game unlock tied to actually receiving Mr. Qi's level-100 Skull Cavern milk reward.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Baby grows into an adult in 5 days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Cannot become pregnant.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Cannot eat a Golden Animal Cracker.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Requires a Milk Pail.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Starts producing Iridium Milk at 3 hearts / 600 friendship.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Produces once every 7 days after the friendship requirement is met.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Iridium Milk permanently adds +25 maximum health and +25 current health.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Real health growth is unlimited; only the HUD bar's physical size is capped.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Health bar grows normally through 205 displayed max health, then keeps the same physical size.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Vanilla and Facelift animal visual styles.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Style setting is localization-ready and can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu when installed.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]One shared package for desktop and Android.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Requirements[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.0.0 or later.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Optional[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — lets you change the Iridium Cow visual style in-game.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50397]Android Custom Animal Shop Fix[/url] — required on the tested Android 1.6.15.3 setup for custom livestock names/descriptions to display correctly in Marnie's purchase menu. Desktop does not need it.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Tested on[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Desktop: Stardew Valley 1.6.15 build 24356, Windows 11, SMAPI 4.5.2, Content Patcher 2.9.1, Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Android: Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 build 26177, SMAPI 4.3.2.5, Content Patcher 2.8.1, Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Installation[/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Android users should also install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50397]Android Custom Animal Shop Fix[/url].[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Extract the Iridium Cow ZIP directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Make sure both folders are present: "Iridium Cow Health Helper" and "[CP] Iridium Cow".[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Credits[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]KhaStark — Iridium Cow design, gameplay implementation, permit edit, cross-platform helper, integration, and packaging.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]ConcernedApe — Stardew Valley; vanilla Iridium Milk artwork and the vanilla document sprite used as the base reference for the Iridium Livestock Permit.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]siamece — Farm Animal Facelift[/url] — optional Facelift-style Iridium Cow art is based on/derived from these assets. The author's Nexus permissions allow asset use/modification with credit, prohibit selling mods/files using the assets, and allow Nexus Donation Points.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Pathoschild — SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/font][/*]
[/list]
